title: Add beluga release team
author: hidmic
body:
* Name of the new release team: beluga
* Release repositories to add:
  <!--
  Before release repositories are created, repositories and packages should be submitted to the official rosdistro repository https://github.com/ros/rosdistro for naming review.
  The ros/rosdistro source entry link must be included for each repository.
  Guidelines for package naming are describe in REP-144: https://www.ros.org/reps/rep-0144.html

  If there are any existing release repositories which should have their contents imported into the ros2-gbp organization, list and link to them here.
  Leave the checkbox _unchecked_. The ros2-gbp administrator will check the box when they have completed the repository import.
  -->
  * [Ekumen-OS/beluga](https://github.com/Ekumen-OS/beluga)
    * [noetic source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/33229c39fb48111a754c18c67a7e85e558fad9a7/noetic/distribution.yaml#L572-L581)
    * [humble source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/33229c39fb48111a754c18c67a7e85e558fad9a7/humble/distribution.yaml#L795-L804)
    * [iron source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/33229c39fb48111a754c18c67a7e85e558fad9a7/iron/distribution.yaml#L617-L626)
    * [jazzy source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/33229c39fb48111a754c18c67a7e85e558fad9a7/jazzy/distribution.yaml#L655-L664)

* Team members
  * @nahueespinosa ([maintainer](https://github.com/Ekumen-OS/beluga/blob/71d3f0cae0588ce2fed1beb847999bf08e2fcf69/beluga_amcl/package.xml#L12))
  * @glpuga ([maintainer](https://github.com/Ekumen-OS/beluga/blob/71d3f0cae0588ce2fed1beb847999bf08e2fcf69/beluga_amcl/package.xml#L9))
  * @hidmic ([maintainer](https://github.com/Ekumen-OS/beluga/blob/71d3f0cae0588ce2fed1beb847999bf08e2fcf69/beluga_amcl/package.xml#L11))
